fields.promptText: Geological research helps scientists understand how landscapes change over time. By examining rock layers, researchers can identify evidence of ancient rivers, volcanic activity, and shifting continents. This knowledge supports careful planning for buildings and roads. It also helps communities prepare for natural hazards by revealing which areas may be more vulnerable to landslides or ground movement.
